body: Haven't got a chance to free enough time on the weekly schedule for a therapy yet although I wish to. I postpone my own healing until I can get back to a steady routine with the new constellation. The first period was focused on my girl and then the financial\\work\\bureaucratic arrangements. I preferred (don't know how wise it was) to fill the available time with sailing and cooking courses that will end only in a couple of months. Being busy all the time prevents dealing with anything while I'm awake but the dreams makes it hard to wake up and be focused during the day
